title: Exactness and full faithfulness at finite level
statement:
For finite $\Lambda$, $\nu_T^*$ is exact, its unit

$$
 F\longrightarrow\nu_{T,*}\nu_T^*F
$$

is an isomorphism for every etale $\Lambda$-module sheaf, and

$$
 R^q\nu_{T,*}\nu_T^*I=0\qquad(q>0)
$$

for every injective etale $\Lambda$-module sheaf $I$.

proof.text: Specialize the existing comparisonUpperStar finite-limit preservation instance to ModuleCat Λ. Its comparisonAdjunction left adjoint structure gives preservation of finite colimits. These are exactly the first two conjuncts.

Apply the existing Grothendieck abelian coefficient comparison unit theorem [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-grothendieck-unit] with A = ModuleCat Λ and take its component at F. The definition proEtaleSiteComparisonModules is comparisonAdjunction, so the component is precisely the unit in the statement.

For the injective I and q > 0, write q = n + 1 by Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-grothendieck-injective-acyclicity] with A = ModuleCat Λ to I and n. By the definition of rightAcyclic its conclusion is exactly the last conjunct. Combine the four clauses by conjunction introduction.
